lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a grid-like configuration. A cluster of four primary spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting horizontal rows of spots to form anchor nodes at the lateral midline and dorsal to the pectoral fin base.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast gradient with maximum luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A jagged, V-shaped notch is present on the posterior margin (trailing edge) of the visible pectoral fin, distal to the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive caustic network (light refraction patterns) is projected across the dorsal and upper lateral surfaces; presence of multiple teleost fish (Naucrates ductor and Echeneidae) clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral gill region.
